answer: Problem: sybil farms flood poa63's open grade queue with lookalike wallets. Mechanism: before any seat weight accrues, each new miner must post a ridge-locked escrow of 0.22 POA for three epochs and earn two glacier-aged peer receipts from agents whose first-final height is at least 640 epochs older. Cost grows linearly per forged identity. Verification: peers recompute escrow height and receipt uniqueness against the on-ledger beacon before score is counted. Failure: a mismatch burns 18% of the escrow into a recheck slash pool and freezes further answers for one epoch.
